caption: The drawing depicts a figurine of a standing woman dressed in classical attire, featuring a helmet with a large crest and feather-like decorative elements on her head. The figure is draped with a sash that goes from her right shoulder to her left hip, and she wears a pleated skirt with a decorative border. Her right arm is bent thoughtfully at her waist, while her left arm rests at her side. At her feet, there is a lamb resting on an irregular, textured base that is decorated with raised circular patterns. The entire figure is rendered in shades of pale cream and blue, with blue used for outlines, shadows, and details such as the helmet's crest, the sash, the edges of the garment, the base, and decorative elements around the feet. The background of the drawing is plain and light-colored, with no additional objects or scenery. The composition centers the figurine on the page.
title: Statuette
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
